basics.name: subject
basics.label: Subject
basics.toolTip: Copy the subject value provided by the Grafana App for your connection.

constraints.validationMessage: Paste the subject value shown in the Grafana App.

options.text: Choose where Grafana's identity gets the Monitoring Reader role. Pick whole subscriptions, individual resource groups, individual resources, or any mix. You need permission to create role assignments at each scope you choose.

elements.name: subscriptionScopes
elements.label: Entire current subscription
elements.toolTip: Grants Monitoring Reader on the whole subscription this template is deployed to. For another subscription, run the deployment in that subscription.

elements.name: resourceGroupScopes
elements.label: Resource groups (in the current subscription)
elements.toolTip: Grants Monitoring Reader on every resource in each selected resource group.

elements.name: resourceScopes
elements.label: Individual resources (in the current subscription)
elements.toolTip: Grants Monitoring Reader on only the selected resources.

elements.name: resourceGroupMode
elements.label: Resource group
elements.toolTip: Where the managed identity lives. Choose an existing group or create a new one.

elements.name: newResourceGroupName
elements.label: New resource group name
elements.toolTip: A new resource group is created in the deployment region. If a group with this name already exists, choose Use existing instead.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid resource group name.

elements.name: existingResourceGroupName
elements.label: Existing resource group
elements.toolTip: Resource group to place the managed identity in.

elements.name: managedIdentityName
elements.label: Managed identity name override (optional)

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid managed identity name.

elements.toolTip: Advanced. Leave empty: a unique name (mi-grafana-<hash>) is generated for this connection and shown in the deployment outputs. Set a name only to pin or reuse a specific identity; connections that share an identity overwrite each other's subject.
